text:
Riley Chen: Heads-up: launching the benchmark teaser next Tue. need to lock post schedule, gating, and who owns inbound.
Sofia Alvarez: Proposed cadence: Day 0 hero + Day 1 methodology carousel + Day 2 customer quote + mid-day thread recaps on X. LinkedIn gets hero + carousel, X gets hero + 2 short threads.
Tom Li: Can we spotlight the 99th percentile tail latency improvement? that's our most defensible stat.
Anika Rao: yes — creative will call out ">3x improvement at p99" and a separate card for "40% lower token cost". I'll produce both with light and dark variants. ETA end of day. @DesignBot can you export templates?
DesignBot: Exporting templates to #creative-assets in 30m. filenames: benchmark-hero-p99.png, benchmark-cost-card.png, carousel-slide-01..04.pdf
Riley Chen: Copy experiments: short punchy vs context-first. Variant A: "3x faster p99 inference — same quality." Variant B: "Lower tail latency, steadier UX at scale." Run A on X, B on LinkedIn.
Sofia Alvarez: For links, we'll gate the deep-dive PDF behind webinar registration (Wed 11am PT). If someone just wants the PDF, they can sign up for "on-demand" after the live event.
Tom Li: SDR routing: GrowthOps @GrowthOps can you confirm assignment rules? want to route enterprise leads differently.
GrowthOps: Routing plan: company_size >= 100 and work_email domain: company -> AE queue, otherwise nurture. Also add a tier for product trials (if company_size < 20 but indicated interest in trial -> Product SDR). We'll deliver webhook + Zapier mapping.
Anika Rao: Paid seeding: $500 first 24h across X promoted post, target dev/platform audiences + product managers on LinkedIn. Pause after 24h to evaluate.
Sofia Alvarez: Engagement plan: reply to top 8 comments within 90 minutes, publish a TL;DR thread comment at 4 hours, and compile top questions to feed into the webinar FAQ.
Tom Li: Measurement: capture CTR, form conversion rate, reply sentiment, and signups by company_size. add UTM: utm_source=social&utm_campaign=bench_q2&utm_medium=organic
Riley Chen: Also include `source=bench_q2_x` param for signups so GrowthOps can use it to route.
DesignBot: GIF idea queued: simple race bar for cost per token. will hand off an MP4 + looping GIF. deadline tomorrow 11am PT.
Sofia Alvarez: Influencer / partner outreach: pinging two partners to retweet during hour 1. will DM and ask for RT + short quote if they can.
GrowthOps: We'll spin up a shared inbox and a Slack webhook for incoming signups. Also enabling round-robin after 15 leads/hour to avoid hot-spots.
Anika Rao: Scheduling tool: we'll use Sprout Social to publish and track. Riley, can you provision access to the contractor?
Riley Chen: Done — contractor has posting access and preview links. I'll schedule once assets are in.
Sofia Alvarez: Checklist: creatives by EOD (Anika), GIF by 11am tomorrow (DesignBot), UTM + gating links (Tom), GrowthOps confirm webhooks (GrowthOps). Dry run Fri 9am PT — calendar invite incoming.
Tom Li: Noted. Also adding a small question form on the webinar registration to tag "use-case" so we can tailor follow-ups.
Riley Chen: Perfect. If anything slips, flag here. :sparkles:
Anika Rao: thanks team.
Sofia Alvarez: +1 — excited to see the early metrics.
